patch_description: Switch from direct additive fields to a smoother sequential deformation: first apply a school-avoidance bend with a sinusoidal endpoint window so the path stays smooth and short, then pull that deflected path toward the base station, and finally add a very small, tightly localized second-stage recovery near the base X position. This is designed to preserve the strong F2 gains from bending away around (40, 20) while improving F3 by nudging the trajectory back toward the base near (70, -30) without globally increasing path length.
